name: BrowserPilot
description: Self-hosted agent that scrapes and navigates websites from a plain-language request using Gemini vision and a stealth browser.
whatItDoes: Collects data from sites, including ones with anti-bot measures, when the user describes what they want. It suits individuals who need scraped data in common formats without writing scrapers.
howItWorks: A FastAPI backend drives a patched Chromium, sends page screenshots to Gemini to decide the next action and streams progress to a web front end. Proxies can be rotated through an optional setting. It runs with docker compose or as a manually started server.
